## Before posting

This issue is public and requires a GitHub account. Do not include player names, saved games, score history, device identifiers, credentials or unreviewed logs and screenshots. For security or privacy-sensitive findings, read the [security reporting policy](../../SECURITY.md). An approved private reporting contact is not available yet.

## What happened?

Describe the problem without private game data. State what you expected instead.

## Steps to reproduce

Use fictional names and a fresh test game where possible. Include the dice count, number of AI opponents and the actions that led to the problem. Do not repeat a roll, hold toggle or score tap after an uncertain result merely to reproduce a report.

## Optional reviewed diagnostics

In the native app, Preview diagnostics shows the allowlisted version/OS/layout/schema information. Nothing is sent when that preview opens or closes. Review that exact text before choosing to copy it here. Do not attach the save database or raw logs.

If saving fails, retain the staged operation and use the app's explicit retry or reload controls. Do not reset damaged data just to file this report.
